column_description: TEXT. Unique case number identifier. PK.
TEXT. Current status of the case. Possible values: CERTIFIED, Certified, certified.
TEXT. Date the case was received. Possible values: 2023/12/21.
TEXT. Date the case decision was made. **NULL means decision date not provided.**. Possible values: 2023-12-29.
DATE. Original certification date. **NULL means certification date not provided.**. Possible values: .
enum_visa_class. Visa class for the case. Possible values: E-3 Australian, H-1B, H-1B1 Chile, H-1B1 Singapore.
TEXT. Job title associated with the case. Example: Registered Nurse.
TEXT. Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) code. Example: 29-1141.00.
TEXT. SOC title for the job role. Example: Registered Nurses.
TEXT. Full-time employment indicator (Y/N). Possible values: 0, 1, N, Y.
TEXT. Start date of employment. Example: 21/12/2023.
TEXT. End date of employment. **NULL means no end date provided.**. Example: 2026 20th Dec..
BIGINT. Total number of worker positions in the case. Possible values: 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 10, 25, 50.
BIGINT. Number of new employment positions. Possible values: 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20.
BIGINT. Number of continued employment positions. Possible values: 0, 1, 2, 5, 10.
BIGINT. Number of changes from previous employment. Possible values: 0, 1, 2, 5.
BIGINT. Number of concurrent new employment positions. Possible values: 0, 1.
BIGINT. Number of employer changes. Possible values: 0, 1, 2, 5, 10.
BIGINT. Flag indicating if the petition is amended. Possible values: 0, 1, 2, 5.
BIGINT. Total number of worksite locations. Possible values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10.
TEXT. Agreement to the labor condition statement. Possible values: Yes.
enum_h1b_dependent. Indicates if the applicant is a dependent under H-1B. Possible values: No, Yes.
enum_willful_violator. Indicates if the employer is a willful violator. Possible values: No.
enum_support_h1b. Indicates if the employer supports H-1B. Possible values: Yes.
TEXT. Statutory basis for the case. Possible values: $60,000 or higher annual wage, Both $60,000 or higher in annual wage and Masters Degree or higher in related specialty.
TEXT. Indicates if Appendix A is attached. Possible values: .
TEXT. Public disclosure status. Possible values: Disclose Business, Disclose Business and Employment, Disclose Employment.
TEXT. Employer reference. FK to employer.corpHandle. Example: Avant Healthcare Professionals, LLC..
TEXT. Employer postal code reference. FK to employer.ZipRef. Example: 32751.
TEXT. Preparer’s email address. FK to preparer.prepMail. Example: tyler.peace@muimmigration.com.
